svg.data-weight-note: 21.2 kg (46.73 lb) with 2 PSUs and 4 fans installed (quick start guide); the datasheet says 21.5 kg (47.4 lb)
svg.data-operating-temp: 0 to 40 C (front-to-back); 0 to 35 C (back-to-front), subject to used optics
svg.data-cpu: Intel Xeon D-1713NTE Ice Lake D, 4-core 2.2 GHz, COM Type 7
svg.data-bmc: AST2600 running OpenBMC, secured by an AST1060 root of trust
svg.data-software: ONIE preloaded; no NOS image ships on the device
svg.data-optics-qsfp-dd: datasheet: each port takes 1 x 800 GbE on 8 lanes of 100G PAM4, or breaks out to 2 x 400G, 4 x 200G or 8 x 100G. Maximum 320 logical ports.
